market_definition: The heat-cure silicone adhesives market comprises addition-cure silicone adhesives that cross-link at elevated temperature to give stable, high-reliability bonds. It measures sales of finished adhesives used in electronics, automotive and medical assembly. BY CURE CHEMISTRY: Platinum Addition-Cure, Peroxide-Cure, Other Heat-Cure Systems. BY COMPONENT TYPE: One-Component, Two-Component. BY CURE TEMPERATURE: Low-Temperature Heat-Cure, Standard Heat-Cure, High-Temperature Cure. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Consumer Electronics, Automotive Electronics & EV Batteries, Industrial & Power Electronics, Telecom & Data Centers, Medical Devices, Aerospace & Defense, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: RTV silicone adhesives; silicone pressure-sensitive adhesives; thermally conductive adhesives sold as such; silicone elastomers and rubbers. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
